summary: Large, multi-domain coercive actor north of the Greater Caucasus. Employs proxies, information operations, cyber pressure, and conventional forces to dominate near-abroad.
Western-leaning state south of the Caucasus ridge. Long history of Donovian pressure, including the disputed Zabzimek region. Small, modern force; limited organic ISR.
Russian-language separatist enclave inside Gorgas. Frequently cited by Donovian media as needing protection.
Energy producer east of Gorgas. Generally neutral; key pipeline and rail corridors.
Land-locked southern Caucasus state. Hosts Donovian basing rights.
Large southern neighbor. Independent regional actor with its own air defense and influence operations.
